name: steam_power_plant_elementary
title: Elementary steam power plant (component balances)
summary: Steam power plant analysed component by component (pump, economiser, steam generator, turbine, condenser) from seven given state points with pressure drops, a thermal loss and significant kinetic energies: turbine power, component heat rates, cooling-water flow rate and overall cycle efficiency.
